title: Circulating Fluidized-bed Combustion Technology — Fig. 1 Process flow of circulating fluidized-bed boiler; Fig. 2 Schematic drawing of CFBC
description: Typical CFBC process flow and schematic: furnace with 4–8 m/s gas velocity, high-temperature cyclone returning coarse bed material/char to the boiler, fluidizing/combustion air preheater and boiler feedwater heater; notes two-stage combustion (reducing bed, oxidizing freeboard) for low NOx.
